UninstallCommand: $setupExe = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\setup.exe'; $exePath = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setupExe) { $setupExe } else { Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'vs_SSMS.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exePath)) { exit 0 }; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $exePath -ArgumentList 'uninstall --installPath "{setting:InstallPath:Detect}" {setting:UIMode} --norestart {setting:ForceClose:Uninstall}' -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow

InstallerSettings.Label: UI mode
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Quiet hides the installer. Passive shows progress only and suits Available deployments better than Required ones.

InstallerSettings.Label: Install path

Detect: C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 22\Release

InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leave empty for the default SSMS 22 path. A path set here is also used for detection and uninstall.

InstallerSettings.Label: Download all packages before installing
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Setup downloads every package before it starts installing instead of installing while downloading.

InstallerSettings.Label: Do not update the Visual Studio Installer
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Skips the installer self-update. Setup can fail when an installer update is required.

InstallerSettings.Label: Include recommended components
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Adds the recommended components of the selected workloads.

InstallerSettings.Label: Include optional components
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Adds the optional components of the selected workloads; larger and slower install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Remove out-of-support components
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Removes components that went out of support during this install or update.

InstallerSettings.Label: Close SSMS if it is running
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Lets setup close running SSMS processes; unsaved query windows are lost.
